safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting the absence of unwell contacts removes an exposure-history element that can help assess likelihood of contagious viral illness (e.g., influenza/COVID) and guide testing, isolation advice, and differential diagnosis. While it likely would not change immediate treatment in this case, it can reduce the quality of clinical reasoning and public health counseling.
